metadata.title: The properties of energetically unbound stars in stellar clusters

notes: No eligible stars. The paper's potential escapers are stars energetically unbound from their host star cluster, not identified as unbound from the Milky Way; the working definition is given at T:p4-b19 ("PEs are stars inside a sphere of radius r_J that have Ê > 0"), and their escape is discussed through cluster Lagrangian points at T:p2-b1. The objects in Table 2 (T:p13-b0) are globular clusters, not individual Galactic-unbound stars, and the introduction's mention of individual high-velocity stars is generic and unnamed (T:p1-b6). No individual star identifiers or Gaia source IDs are supplied for any retained Galactic-unbound candidate.
